meta.name: scrapecreators-api
meta.description: Scrape and extract public data from 27+ social media platforms using the ScrapeCreators REST API. Covers TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Snapchat, Twitch, Kick, Truth Social, TikTok Shop, Google, and link-in-bio services (Linktree, Komi, Pillar, Linkbio, Linkme, Amazon Shop). Use when the user asks to scrape, fetch, extract, search, or look up social media profiles, posts, videos, reels, comments, transcripts, followers, ads, hashtags, trending content, or engagement metrics from any social platform. Also use when user mentions ScrapeCreators, social media API, ad library, or creator data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从27+社交平台抓取公开资料与互动数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要从多个社交平台批量获取公开数据用于分析或看板。
copy.tagline_en: Extract public posts and profiles from 27+ social media platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk-collect public data from social platforms for analysis or dashboards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 ScrapeCreators 接口,按你的要求抓取 27 多个社交平台的公开资料,如主页、帖子、视频、评论、字幕、粉丝数、广告和热门内容,并以 JSON 返回。
howto.when: 当用户提到要抓取、获取或搜索社交平台的主页、视频、评论等内容,或提到 ScrapeCreators、社交 API、创作者数据等时触发。

say.text: 抓一下这个 TikTok 用户的主页资料。
查一下这条 YouTube 视频的评论。
say.note: 会调用视频评论接口返回评论列表。

say.text: 搜一下 Instagram 上关于 dogs 的 Reels。
say.note: 会调用 Reels 搜索接口返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call the ScrapeCreators REST API to fetch public data from 27+ social platforms and return JSON results (profiles, posts, videos, comments, transcripts, followers, ads, trending content).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to scrape, fetch, extract, search, or look up social media profiles, posts, videos, comments, or mentions ScrapeCreators, social media API, ad library, or creator data.

say_en.note: Calls the TikTok profile endpoint and returns public info.

say_en.text: Get comments for this YouTube video.
say_en.note: Calls the video comments endpoint and returns the list.
Calls the Reels search endpoint and returns results.
